item.title: Counter Campaign
item.description: This is a simple campaign that counts from a given value up to 20. It contains a single providers.stage.counter stage, which takes an input value, val, increments it by 1, and passes the updated value through the trigger for the next stage. A conditional stage selector selects the next stage. If val is less than 20, the selector routes execution back to the same counter stage, creating a loop. Once val reaches 20, the selector chooses an empty stage instead, terminating the campaign.
